journey.name: fast transfer relaunch
journey.description:
Verifies that a Fast transfer to spending keeps its speed and its fee prompt after a relaunch: the "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner shows and opens the transfer at once, still at the fast speed, a changed fee still asks Wait or Approve, and the transfer still claims early within the fee approved. Whether Spark reprices the fast transfer is the provider's call, so the fee prompt steps are conditional; SparkTransferFlowTests' relaunch tests cover the kept claim, the kept choice and the resumed early claim.
Precondition: as in spark-transfer-to-spending.xml: a dev build with Spark connected on its regtest and reading Bitkit's chain, Savings funded on that chain (at least 20 000 sats, confirmed) and no channels. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Savings balance card (id "ActivitySavings"), tap "Transfer To Spending" (id "TransferToSpending"), tap "Get Started" (id "SpendingIntro-button") if the intro appears, tap "25%" (id "SpendingAmountQuarter") and tap "Continue" (id "SpendingAmountContinue")
Verify "Fast" (id "SpendingConfirmInstant") is selected and swipe the "Swipe To Transfer" handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right
Verify the status screen (id "LightningSettingUp") opens with the text (id "SettingUpText") ending "This should take a few minutes.", then tap "Continue Using Bitkit" (id "TransferSuccess-button")

Relaunch the app at once, verify Home shows the "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner (id "ActivityBanner"), tap it and verify the status screen opens at once at the same or a later step, with the text still ending "This should take a few minutes." or the headline "Fast transfer fee changed", never "about 30 minutes."

If the headline is "Fast transfer fee changed", verify "Wait" (id "SparkDepositWait") and "Approve" (id "SparkDepositPay"), relaunch the app, tap the banner and verify the same headline with both buttons; tap "Approve" and verify the label "Adding To Spending Balance" or "Transfer Successful" (id "TransferSuccess") follows
Otherwise wait up to 3 minutes for "Transfer Successful" (id "TransferSuccess"), the label never showing "Using Normal Transfer Speed"
Tap "Awesome!" (id "TransferSuccess-button"), verify Home no longer shows the banner, relaunch the app and verify the banner stays gone
